item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Feroz studies the diagram of figures $F$ and $G$. Figure $G$ is the same shape and size as figure $F$, and $G$ is shown after a flip.

Which claim correctly decides whether $F$ and $G$ are congruent?

options.A: $F$ and $G$ are congruent: same shape and size under exact superimposition, and flipping is allowed.
options.B: $F$ and $G$ are congruent because they are both called figures on the page.
options.C: Exact fit under superimposition is needed only after congruence is already known.
options.D: Congruence here requires a right angle, hypotenuse, and one matching side before the flip can be used.
